name: A tile opens into its card
visual_intent: Open a detail view from the object that stands for it (app icon to screen, chip to card, gauge to panel).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Target card (laid out in the incoming scene)

parameters.name: outTarget
parameters.description: Outgoing scene, cut at the hand-off

parameters.name: inTarget
parameters.description: Incoming scene, shown at the hand-off

timeline_requirements.gsap_instance: Timeline passed to Studio.build(builder) (registered as window.__timelines['root'])
timeline_requirements.timing_anchors: Cue map (Studio.cues) or word times (Studio.cues.fromWords); place it on the word or beat it illustrates

code_snippet.javascript:
// animate the card's own content only after the hand-off (the transform already showed a snapshot of it)
var opened = Studio.fx.containerTransform(tl, '#tile', '#card', cue('open'), { outTarget: '#s1', inTarget: '#s2' });

fallbacks: Studio.fx.bloom from the tile (colour continuity without the box), or Studio.fx.matchCut when the shapes differ too much.

performance_characteristics.memory_impact: Low; estimate, not measured on the M2

validation_steps: On the render host: hyperframes snapshot mid-transform and at the hand-off

validation.evidence: Runtime checks tests/studio-runtime/backlog-techniques.html in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-11-28.
